[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Grothmar Wardowns]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Grothmar Wardowns in the [[Charr Homelands]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 10,000 [[Experience]]
* 1,500 [[Gold]]
* 3,500 [[Vanguard rank|Vanguard reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 150 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
